walkthroughs.body_html:
CO = HR × SV.

72 bpm × 70 ml = 5040 ml/min ≈ 5 L/min. Exercise raises both — CO can reach 25 L/min in athletes.

For a cube of side L: SA = 6L², V = L³, SA:V = 6 ÷ L.

Side 3 cm → 6 ÷ 3 = 2:1. Side 6 cm → 6 ÷ 6 = 1:1.

Minute ventilation = tidal volume × breathing rate.

0.5 dm³ × 16 = 8 dm³/min at rest.

mcqs.q: How do hormones reach their target organs?
options: They are carried in the bloodstream and act on cells with specific receptors for that hormone.
Respiration is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight.
Hormones are sent through nerves directly to specific organs.
Hormones are released directly into target organs by being injected by glands.

mcqs.q: Why does the left ventricle have a thicker muscular wall than the right?
options: The left ventricle is thicker because it handles oxygenated blood, which is harder to pump.
The left ventricle is thicker because it is on the same side as the brain.
Respiration is the process by which plants make their own food using sunlight.
It must pump blood at high pressure around the whole body; the right ventricle only pumps to the nearby lungs.
